A turbine governor has a single active droop percentage setting at any instant and cannot simultaneously be set to droop8pct and droop4pct.
A single-circuit chiller charged with an unblended refrigerant cannot simultaneously use ammonia and carbondioxide.

Blended phosphate-chelant (phosphate-EDTA) programs are used in industrial boilers, so congruentphosphate and edtachelant are compatible under a combined-program reading unless 'sole' is read as forbidding hybrid chemical regimens.

An intercooler tube circuit using a single unblended coolant cannot simultaneously contain ambientair and mineraloil unless a multi-stage compressor cools different intercooler stages with different media.
API 610 pump configuration codes are mutually exclusive architectural classifications; a single pump cannot be both vs1 and oh3.
